name: load_toolset
description: Load a toolset by name so its tools appear in tools/list and can be called. Returns the list of tools that were added. Use list_toolboxes() first to see valid names. Pass an array to load several toolsets in one call -- cheaper, one tools/list refresh.

name.description: Toolset name (e.g. 'sch_components', 'pcb_routing'), or an array of names
